title: Naturality of resolution section homology equivalences
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $G$, and $J$ an injective resolution of $g^{-1}G$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ be a cochain map with $I.\iota^0\alpha^0=\eta_{g,G}g_*(J.\iota^0)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let $c_X,c_Y$ be section-homology comparisons normalized on representing Ext cocycles [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Their four equivalence families satisfy all six prescribed identities: whole-to-open restriction, open inclusion restriction on X and Y, and global and open transfer for alpha [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer], with cohomologyMap, openCohomologyRestriction, and openCohomologyPullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. This is asserted for normalized comparisons, not for arbitrary additive equivalences.

source.place: Tag 0A50, proof (naturality of the resolution-section comparison).

proof.text: Apply single-scheme normalized restriction naturality to I and to J; this gives the first four identities.
Apply normalized transfer naturality to the prescribed alpha and its augmentation equation; this gives the final two identities. Assemble the six conjuncts.

statement_change.what: The old Lean statement universally quantified over arbitrary additive equivalences, although the node described the canonical comparison. Independent negation of an equivalence contradicts a nonzero identity map. Specify comparisons by their independently defined values on Ext cocycles; the caller still asserts existence of all six compatible families. This is a repair, not a proof of the false universal assertion.
